title: rl-triton: High-Performance Triton GPU Kernels for Reinforcement Learning Credit Assignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.17641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present rl-triton, an open-source library of high-performance GPU kernels for reinforcement learning credit assignment, implemented in Triton. The core contribution is a unified associative scan framework that recasts seven distinct RL estimation algorithms - Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE), V-Trace, Retrace($\lambda$), TD($\lambda$) returns, discounted returns, eligibility traces, and episodic prefix sums - as instances of a single first-order linear recurrence solved in $O(\log T)$ parallel steps. All algorithms share the same associative scan operator, with algorithm-specific fused Triton kernels constructing their recurrence coefficients on-chip. We verify the associative operator algebraically and define the treatment of terminated and truncated episodes explicitly. translated_title: rl-triton：用于强化学习信用分配的高性能Triton GPU内核
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17641v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出了rl-triton，一个用Triton实现的开源高性能GPU内核库，用于强化学习信用分配。核心贡献是一个统一的关联扫描框架，将七种不同的强化学习估计算法——广义优势估计（GAE）、V-Trace、Retrace($\lambda$)、TD($\lambda$)回报、折扣回报、资格迹和情节前缀和——重铸为单个一阶线性递推的实例，该递推在$O(\log T)$并行步骤内求解。所有算法共享相同的关联扫描算子，具有算法特定融合的Triton内核在芯片上构建其递推系数。我们在代数上验证了关联算子，并明确定义了终止和截断情节的处理方式。基准测试显示，在大规模并行模拟场景（数千个环境）中，与向量化的torch.compile基线相比，全调用速度提升1.6-5.70倍。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的关联扫描框架，通过Triton内核高效实现七种强化学习信用分配算法，显著提升了大规模并行场景下的计算速度。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified associative scan framework that efficiently implements seven reinforcement learning credit assignment algorithms via Triton kernels, significantly boosting computational speed in massively parallel scenarios.
